champions.name: EMBERLING
champions.lore: The youngest of the Hoard, Vexalith's brood. The Burrow has drawn it on every wall.

champions.name: CINDERA
champions.lore: It cuts a mark for every thief the gold lures down. The Crew's marks fill a wall.

champions.name: ASHKA
champions.lore: It burns thieves on sight. The Coil tells it where the Crew hides, and calls that even.

champions.name: SCORIA
champions.lore: The Old Stone goes quiet this deep. Under the floor, the Last Door is breathing.

champions.name: VEXALITH
champions.lore: It built all this to catch the greedy, and waits at the Last Door for one who isn't alone.

premise.title: THE LAST DOOR
premise.banner: Five floors down, and the only way out.
premise.door: It only opens for someone who is not alone.
premise.line: You reached for the Hoard's gold. It was bait. The Last Door is five floors down.

test_room.title: THE TEST ROOM
test_room.banner: Every monster there is stands here. Walk into one to fight it. Nothing done here is kept.
test_room.line: B1F's kinds stand in the first row and deeper floors behind it, then the elites, then the champions; the lord on the aisle asks a favour.
test_room.champion: %s, the champion of B%dF: %d HP, and every attack of its floor.
test_room.beside: %s on your left, %s on your right.
test_room.reset: The room is as it was, and so are you.
test_room.out: The way out of the test room.
test_room.menu_sub: Every monster in one room. Nothing is kept.

practice.line: A quiet landing above B1F: one slime, then the stairs down.
practice.done: That was the landing. B1F is below, and the run starts there.
practice.down_sub: To B1F, where the run starts

toll.ask: The gate here drops unless someone holds its chain, and whoever holds it stays.
toll.hold_sub: Nobody stays, and the gate catches you on the way under: %d HP
toll.leave_sub: It holds the gate and stays behind. The others will remember it
toll.held: You hold it, you run, and the gate catches you going under. %d HP.
toll.left: %s takes the chain and doesn't look at you. You go down without it.
toll.others: Nobody says anything for a long time.

paths.label: THE STEEP STAIR
paths.sub: Tougher monsters below, and a purse on the way down: +6 gold

paths.label: THE QUIET STAIR
paths.sub: Fewer monsters below, and a longer rest on the way: +6 HP

paths.label: THE MARKET STAIR
paths.sub: A trader waits below, and the walk is no easier

paths.label: THE %s WARREN
paths.sub: Every monster below is %s: make friends or enemies in bulk

instinct.title: EXPLORER'S INSTINCT
instinct.text: You have walked enough of this floor to know how the rest must run.
instinct.line: The rest of the floor is on your map now, and the stairs with it.

map.title: A MAP
map.text: %s was carrying a map of this floor.
map.line: %s was carrying a map of this floor. The rest of it is on your map now, and the stairs with it.

friend.title: WICK
friend.line: A very small witch hops up and hands you a heart. She lights the torches here.
friend.joined: She has decided to come with you.
friend.line_film: That was Wick. She lights the torches here.
